SchoolProfile.title: SchoolProfile
SchoolProfile.description: Teacher's school letterhead (Kop Surat) and display identity for official exam reports.

userId.description: Authenticated teacher UID matching document ID.

namaDinas.description: Department or provincial education authority header.

namaSekolah.description: School name displayed in report header.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: A CBT exam package created by a teacher.

ownerId.description: Authenticated teacher UID who owns the exam.

active.description: Whether this exam is currently active for student access.

tokenSusulan.description: Optional make-up exam token; empty string means regular mode.

questionCount.description: Cached number of questions in this exam.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Multiple-choice question belonging to an exam.

ownerId.description: Denormalized teacher UID matching parent exam ownerId.

examActive.description: Denormalized active status of parent exam for rule-enforced student queries.

jawabanBenar.description: Exact text of the correct option.

ExamResult.title: ExamResult
ExamResult.description: Locked student exam score submission. Immutable once created; teacher can delete to unlock for make-up exam.

examOwnerId.description: Denormalized teacher UID of the parent exam.

studentUid.description: Authenticated UID of the student device submitting the result.

kelas.description: Student class or ID number (Kelas / NIM).

studentKey.description: Normalized lowercase nama|kelas key for duplicate prevention.

totalCount.description: Total number of questions in the exam.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-teacher school identity and Kop Surat settings.

/exams/{examId}.description: CBT exam packages owned by teachers and accessible to students by ID when active.

/exams/{examId}/questions/{questionId}.description: Multiple-choice questions belonging to an exam.

/exams/{examId}/results/{resultId}.description: Permanently locked student submissions keyed deterministically by student identity.
